question: During the year 1991–92, the industrial production recorded a _______ growth of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**positive; 0.6 Percent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the year 1991–92, **industrial production** recorded a **positive** growth of **0.6 Percent**.
 
• In 1991–92, industrial production in India remained nearly unchanged compared to the previous year, with the General Index of Industrial Production (IIP) showing a marginal decline of 0.1%.
 
• This lack of growth was primarily attributed to the underperformance of the mining and manufacturing sectors. However, starting from the fiscal year 1992–93, there was a notable improvement in the industrial growth rate.
 
• Over the subsequent years, the growth trend exhibited a steady increase: 2.3% growth in 1992–93, 6% in 1993–94, 9.4% in 1994–95, and further escalating to 12.1% in 1995–96.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) **serves as a metric for gauging the performance of different industrial sectors within the Indian economy.
 
• Published monthly by the Central Statistical Organisation (CSO), it offers a composite overview of the overall industrial activity level in the economy. 
 
• The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) provides growth rates for various industry groups within the economy over a defined period of time.
